author: /root/saved_portrait_ui
scope: Independent review of frozen UI/world portrait changes. The reviewer authored server code; server implementation is reviewed separately by /root and /root/portrait_asset_editor.
threatModelDelta: Gameplay renders a bounded server-produced PNG data URL from the authenticated response. No external image URL, SVG, user-uploaded image, client renderer or personal player enters gameplay. Fitting drafts remain account-local until a confirmed save.
checks: PNG-only display guard enforces 160×160, SHA256 shape, a 175000-character maximum and bounded base64 padding; unavailable images use a neutral placeholder.
AvatarEditor preserves the saved portrait on failed save, applies only authoritative responses for the same owner, and ignores late responses after account changes or unmount.
App keys identity consumers by user ID and independently checks the owner when applying saved-user callbacks.
Hub uses the saved user portrait. Shift and existing Blitz sessions use only their historical equipment portrait; a missing historical image is never replaced with the current user image.
Both accepted-art and procedural-fallback campus paths have no personal player creation, movement, animation or profile bridge.
Static fitting preview remains isolated to the editor; lifecycle cleanup releases obsolete composites and schedules no animation.

resolvedFindings.issue: Procedural HubNpcLayer fallback still created and animated a generic player.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Player creation, container, movement and breathing update removed; employee NPCs remain.

resolvedFindings.issue: Broken historical portrait suggested a new wardrobe save would repair an old round.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Neutral unavailable label with optional contextual override.

resolvedFindings.issue: Display guard had no data URL length limit and allowed arbitrary base64 padding.
resolvedFindings.resolution: 175000-character cap and zero to two padding characters.

resolvedFindings.issue: App relied solely on editor lifecycle guards when replacing the current account.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Functional onSaved setter applies the response only to the same current user ID.

limitations: Deterministic component and event doubles, not a real browser layout or GPU measurement.
This report does not claim independent server authentication, PNG decoding or scientific-content validation.
